overviewHtml:
Alerts often reach a shared inbox, and the people who own the affected service have to dig for context in the logs before they can act on the event.

What you get

  • A trigger on matching events
  • A DQL query that fetches the related log lines
  • An owner lookup through Dynatrace ownership
  • An email to the owners that includes the logs
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • Email for Workflows (the workflow actor needs email:emails:send)
  • Ownership teams with email contacts assigned to your entities
setupHtml:
1. Download email-entity-owner-notification.workflow-template.yaml.
  2. In Workflows, choose Upload and select the file.
  3. Adjust the trigger (see Configuration) and activate the workflow.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Email for Workflows and ownership teams with email contacts.

  1. Upload the workflow template in Workflows
  2. Adjust the trigger to the events you care about
  3. Activate the workflow
